title: Membership Fee Model Comparison
description: Flat fee against sliding scale on the same families -- with the reach that a revenue bar alone does not show.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Expenses and Building Funding Partnerships

educational.audience: Club leaders deciding how to charge

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a number of families and a distribution of self-selected fee tiers, the learner calculates and compares total annual revenue under a flat membership fee model versus a sliding scale fee model.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Set how many families sit at each tier, and what a flat fee would be, and compare
pedagogical.assessment: Find a mix where the sliding scale wins on both revenue and reach.
